exposure: MRI findings (lacunae, abnormal bladder interface, T1 hyperintensity, dark T2 bands)
short interval pregnancy less than 18 months
Patients with suspected placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
history of dilation and curettage (D&C) or dilation and evacuation (D&E)
Patients with confirmed PAS on pathology
outcome: accuracy of MRI in diagnosing PAS
cohort: 353 patients evaluated for PAS by MRI
finding: While MRI is a valuable tool for diagnosing PAS, its accuracy is limited by factors such as the presence of dark T2 bands (associated with overdiagnosis), gestational age at MRI, and lateral placentation (associated with underdiagnosis).
gest_age: Varied, but underdiagnosis of PAS was associated with earlier gestational age at MRI (28 vs. 30 weeks)
